subject: CPPO listing asset mapping + co-sell pitch alignment
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam@resellco.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 26 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: CPPO listing asset mapping + co-sell pitch alignment

Hi Liam —

Thanks again for taking the intro call last week. To keep momentum toward the CPPO activation I wanted to map out the minimum listing assets and a short co-sell pitch bundle so we can align enables on both sides. Can you drop the items below into a shared folder or reply with attachments?

Requested assets (minimal set):
- Product matrix (SKU / entitlements / typical commit sizes)
- One-pager pitch for marketplace listing (customer problem, top features, sample customers)
- Listing metadata (short/long descriptions, logo files, example screenshots)
- Lead routing and attribution contact (email + HubSpot owner)
- Any required legal evidence (reseller agreement, marketplace vetting)

Target dates: what does a 2–3 week turnaround look like on your side for getting assets and a final review? Our target go-live window is the week of June 21 if we can lock this down quickly.

I've attached our recommended play (redwood_co-sell-play.pdf) and a lightweight metadata checklist (listing_metadata_checklist.csv) to make this easier. Ben — can you confirm commission schedule constraints (ranges) so Liam has something to model against? Vanessa — would love your help owning listing validation once the assets land.

Thanks,
Naomi Feldman
Channel Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
naomi_feldman@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0172

Attachments: redwood_co-sell-play.pdf, listing_metadata_checklist.csv

From: Liam O'Connor <liam@resellco.com>

Subject: Re: CPPO listing asset mapping + co-sell pitch alignment

Hi Naomi —

Thanks — attaching the product matrix (resellco_product_matrix.xlsx) and a draft one-pager. We're comfortable with the June 21 window if we can finalize margins and the lead routing. A couple quick things from our side:

- Attached product matrix includes SKU IDs and example commit sizes. 
- We usually collect marketplace commission on a net revenue basis; curious how Redwood wants to model that in the CPPO.
- Lead routing: can you confirm the HubSpot owner mapping format you prefer? We can map leads to rep IDs or to a shared queue.

Happy to hop on a 30m sync — I'm available Thursday 5/27 between 10:00-12:00 PT.

Best,

On Wed, May 26, 2027 at 01:45 PM Liam O'Connor <liam@resellco.com> wrote:
> Thanks — attaching the product matrix (resellco_product_matrix.xlsx) and a draft one-pager. We're comfortable with the June 21 window if we can finalize margins and the lead routing.

Hi Liam — perfect, thanks for the quick turnaround and the attachments.Thursday 5/27 10:30 PT works for us; I'll send a calendar invite.

Quick answers before the sync:
- HubSpot routing: we typically map to rep IDs for initial inbound attribution then route to a shared queue for partner-sourced leads. We'll share the HubSpot owner template in the sync.
- Commission / margin: Ben — can you post the initial draft commission bands to the thread before our call? If we need special commercial terms for large commitments we can escalate to finance but want to start with the standard CPPO bands.
- Vanessa — please lead listing validation (assets/metadata + screenshots). We'll use the metadata checklist I attached to speed review.

Agenda for Thursday (30m):
1) Quick review of ResellCo product matrix (5m)
2) Commission bands & examples (Ben) (7m)
3) Listing metadata gaps and sample screenshots (Vanessa) (10m)
4) Next steps, HubSpot owner mapping, and timeline to June 21 (8m)

Thanks — sending invite now.

Naomi

Attachments referenced: listing_metadata_checklist.csv

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>

Naomi / Vanessa — quick internal note after reviewing ResellCo's matrix.

- I drafted a commission schedule (commission_schedule_draft.xlsx) that maps three tiers: starter (<$50k ARR), growth ($50k–$250k ARR), enterprise (>$250k ARR). Tiered % and CPPO handling are in the spreadsheet.
- Red flags: a couple of ResellCo SKUs are nested bundles that will need clarified entitlements for marketplace SKU mapping. I'll mark those rows in the workbook.
- Legal evidence: we'll need a signed reseller agreement and confirmation of customer references for higher-tier approvals. Vanessa, please include "required evidence" as a checklist item during listing validation.

I'll upload the draft to the shared drive at https://redwood.app/drive/resellco/pitch-deck and circulate a clean version after the call.
